description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved across six different datasets for four distinct model configurations. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Dataset", displays the datasets in the following order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical value axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Within each dataset category, the data is visually arranged into a cluster of four adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned below the chart, the colors represent different model variations: a green bar (whose corresponding text label is obscured by a gray rectangle), a purple bar labeled "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", a blue bar labeled "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", and an orange bar labeled "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". Across the chart, the green bars consistently display the highest values within each group, including the overall tallest bar in the PSM dataset at approximately 97%. Conversely, the shortest bar in the chart is the purple bar in the WADI dataset, which indicates a value of approximately 62%. Other representative values include the blue bar in the PSM dataset at roughly 77% and the orange bar in the SMAP dataset at approximately 67%. The dataset categories are not sorted alphabetically or by a strict ascending or descending value trend, and all bars are uniformly styled with solid fill colors and thin black outlines, without any specific visual emphasis.
